content.user_title: Research and Restyle App Store Screenshots
content.value_statement: Planning App Store screenshots requires real references and consistent visual decisions. MagicScreenshots connects listing research with approved screenshot restyling and localization workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search app listings by query, category, chart, style tag, and iOS platform through the connected service.
Inspect listing details and ordered screenshots to compare headlines, colors, device treatment, and benefit sequences.
Find app preview references and listing history through the documented tools, subject to service access requirements.
Start approved restyling jobs using the user's source app and a selected reference app slug.
Request screenshot localization for selected locales and poll for each locale's output.
Retrieve job overviews, request human design approval, and obtain completed output URLs.
limitations: The skill provides workflow instructions, not a bundled rendering engine; service operations require a working MCP connection or CLI.
Authenticated operations require secure setup and spending approval; Pro access applies to downloads and history.
The reference library contains App Store marketing images, not arbitrary in-app UI captures; third-party assets cannot be shipped as your work.
Jobs are asynchronous, overviews are not final outputs, and Pro video links expire after one hour.

use_cases.title: Compare Listing Designs
use_cases.description: Inspect relevant app screenshots and summarize visible layout, headline, and benefit-order patterns for a design brief.

use_cases.title: Restyle Launch Screenshots
use_cases.description: Select a reference, confirm the source app and spending limit, then review an overview before approving final screenshot generation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Localized Listings
use_cases.description: Request approved screenshot translations for selected locales and track each locale until completed outputs are available.

prompt_templates.title: Find Screenshot References
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three iOS apps in [category] using public library tools. Show their actual listing screenshots and cite the apps you inspect.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Visual Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare five real listings for [audience]. Analyze headlines, colors, device treatment, and benefit order. Recommend patterns relevant to [my app's actual features].

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Screenshot Restyling
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle screenshots for [my app] using [reference slug]. Confirm app identity, secure authentication, and [spending limit] before starting. Await my overview approval.

prompt_templates.title: Track Multi-Locale Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan localization for [my app] into [target locales]. Confirm secure authentication and [spending limit] before starting. Track each locale and report completed outputs.

output_examples.input: Start screenshot restyling, but I have not provided a spending limit.
output_examples.output: Restyling has not started. Please confirm your source app, reference app, and spending limit before any paid operation.

output_examples.input: The restyling job returned an overview. Are the screenshots finished?
output_examples.output: The overview is ready for your review. Final screenshots are not complete. Generation will continue only after you approve the design.

output_examples.input: Can I submit another app's reference screenshots as my own listing?
output_examples.output: No. Use those images only as design references. Your listing screenshots must represent your own app and its actual features.

best_practices: Inspect actual screenshot sequences and cite the apps used as references.
Use secure authentication and confirm the source app, paid operation, and spending limit before generation.
Review the overview before approval and verify final screenshots against the app's actual features.
anti_patterns: Inventing listing details, chart positions, visual styles, or completed job results.
Starting chargeable operations or approving designs without explicit human consent.
Reusing third-party screenshots or preview footage as your app's original marketing assets.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides instructions for researching app listings and coordinating screenshot restyling or localization through MagicScreenshots tools.

faq.question: Do public library searches require an API key?
faq.answer: Public library search and read tools require no key. Authenticated features need secure setup through a supported connection or CLI configuration.

faq.question: Can the assistant handle my credentials in chat?
faq.answer: No. Credentials must not appear in conversation or tool arguments. Without secure authentication, use public reads and complete paid workflows on the website.

faq.question: When can paid generation begin?
faq.answer: Only after you confirm the paid operation and spending limit. Restyling also requires your design approval after the overview appears.

faq.question: Can I reuse reference screenshots or videos?
faq.answer: No. Their developers own them. Use them as references, and ensure your generated screenshots accurately represent your own app.

faq.question: Does an overview mean the job is complete?
faq.answer: No. An overview is a review stage. Approve the design when ready, then poll for the final output URLs.
